claims: Catherine (2011) is a mature action-puzzle game by Atlus.
Catherine (2011) focuses on Vincent who faces nightmares and relationship turmoil between his long-term girlfriend Katherine and a new lover Catherine.
Players climb block-based towers to survive.
Full Body (2019) is an enhanced version.
Catherine was originally released on July 25, 2011, for Xbox 360 and PlayStation 3.
Catherine is an action-adventure, puzzle, romantic thriller game.
Players climb shifting block towers in Vincent's nightmares.
Players escape monstrous manifestations of Vincent's fears.
Full Body (2019) was released on PlayStation 4 and PlayStation Vita.
Full Body (2019) features a third love interest Rin.
Full Body was released on Nintendo Switch in 2020.
Catherine Classic is available on Steam.
